mapper.select:
select a.*, b.CX_CLASS1_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS2_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS3_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS4_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS5_PLAN from ( select max(cxr.SCHEDULE_DATE) SCHEDULE_DATE, /*排程日期*/ max(cxr.BATCH_NO) TQ_BATCH_NO, /*胎圈批次号*/ ci.BEAD_CODE STEEL_RING_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ max(ci.BEAD_TYPE) STEEL_TYPE, /*钢丝类型*/ max(ci.BEAD_ARRANGE) RANK, /*排列*/ 2 unit_consume, /*对应成型单耗*/ nvl(sum(cxr.MID_PLAN_QTY + NIGHT_PLAN_QTY),0) MID_PLAN_QTY, /* 中班计划量=胎圈中班计划量 + 胎圈夜班计划量 */ nvl(sum(cxr.DAY_PLAN_QTY),0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /* 夜班计划量 = 胎圈白班计划量 */ nvl(sum(cxr.NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY),0) DAY_PLAN_QTY /* 白班的计划量 = 胎圈次日中班计划量 */ from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*胎圈排程结果表*/ inner join (SELECT TIRE_RING_CODE, MAX(BEAD_CODE) BEAD_CODE, MAX(BEAD_ARRANGE) BEAD_ARRANGE, MAX(BEAD_TYPE) BEAD_TYPE FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
and PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
GROUP BY TIRE_RING_CODE) ci on cxr.BEAD_CODE = ci.TIRE_RING_CODE /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.BEAD_CODE) a left join ( select BEAD_CODE, nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, /*对应成型一班的钢丝圈胶计划量=成型计划量*2 */ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, /*对应成型三班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, /*对应成型次一班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN /*对应成型次二班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.BEAD_CODE ) b on a.STEEL_RING_CODE = b.BEAD_CODE

select ci.BEAD_CODE STEEL_RING_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ regexp_replace(listagg(cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE||'$'||cxr.EMBRYO_CODE||'$'||cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION,',') within group (order by cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION), '([^,]+)(,\1)+', '\1') as quotaKeys /*机台code$胎胚代码*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
group by ci.BEAD_CODE
mapper.insert: insert into T_GSQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT_LOG (ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, TQ_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, STEEL_TYPE, STEEL_RING_CODE, RANK, MACHINE_ID, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_FINISH_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_FINISH_RATE, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME,data_source, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME) select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, TQ_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, STEEL_TYPE, STEEL_RING_CODE, RANK, MACHINE_ID, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_FINISH_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_FINISH_RATE, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME,data_source, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME from T_GSQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.delete: delete from T_GSQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.update: update T_GSQ_ASSIST_SCHEDULE set DEL_FLAG = '1', UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.insert: insert into T_GSQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD (ID, TQ_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, STATUS, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG) values (SEQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD.Nextval, #{tqBatchNo}, #{batchNo}, '0', to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd'), #{userName}, sysdate, '0')
mapper.select: select param_code, param_value from T_GSQ_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM t_gsq_auto_schedule_record where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')

select c.BEAD_CODE steelRingCode, max(c.BEAD_ARRANGE) rank, max(c.BEAD_TYPE) steelType from T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO c where c.Del_Flag = '0'
and PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and c.BEAD_CODE in #{steelRingCode} group by c.BEAD_CODE

select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, TQ_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, STEEL_TYPE, STEEL_RING_CODE, RANK, MACHINE_ID, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, nvl(MID_PLAN_QTY,0) MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_FINISH_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_FINISH_RATE, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, nvl(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, nvl(DAY_PLAN_QTY,0) DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DATA_SOURCE,PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME from t_gsq_schedule_result r where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and DEL_FLAG = 0

select cxr.EMBRYO_CODE || ',' ||ci.EMBRYO_CODE EMBRYO_CODE, /*成型排程胎胚代码，施工表的胎胚代码*/ cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION || ',' || ci.EMBRYO_VERSION as BOM_DATA_VERSION, /*成型排程胎胚版本，施工表的胎胚版本*/ ci.BEAD_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ ci.BEAD_TYPE, ci.BEAD_ARRANGE, /*排列*/ ci.DIMENSION /*寸口*/ from ( select EMBRYO_CODE,BOM_DATA_VERSION from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT where DEL_FLAG = 0 and schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ left join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where 1=1
and (ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0' or ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE is null)
select MATERIAL_CODE from T_GSQ_ASSIST_SPEC where DEL_FLAG='0'
